name: hydracept
description: Quote and run text, reasoning, and domain capabilities with durable jobs, artifacts, and receipts. OAuth sign-in. Does not generate images, video, audio, or 3D.

interface.shortDescription: Quote and run text capabilities with durable jobs and receipts.
interface.longDescription: Hydracept quotes and runs text, reasoning, structured, embedding, classification, translation, and domain capabilities for the signed-in account. Jobs are durable. A finished job has an artifact and a sealed receipt. OAuth sign-in. This connector does not generate images, video, audio, or 3D, and it does not transfer money.
